RECE.name: Received
RECE.definition: Cancellation instruction/request has been received, that is, technical validation of the message is ok, and the message is now at the receiving side.

PACK.name: Accepted
PACK.definition: Cancellation instruction / request has been received and has been acknowledged / accepted for further processing.

STNP.name: Sent To Next Party
STNP.definition: Cancellation instruction/request has been sent to the next party, that is, the next intermediary.
